dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have one that'll give me a beach bod like yours?

dialogues.speaker: Mazatl
dialogues.text: Hey, you! Do you want a body like mine?

dialogues.speaker: Mazatl
dialogues.text: It might not be plausible, but it's probably not totally impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Is that a yes or a no?

dialogues.speaker: Mazatl
dialogues.text: It's probably a yes — put on a prickly pear suit and you'll turn into a prickly pear, so if you put on a muscle suit, you'll become a chiseled masterpiece!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let me see your muscle suits.

dialogues.speaker: Mazatl
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, you wanted to buy one... I thought we were just discussing hypotheticals. We don't actually stock muscle suits here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So it was a no all along!!!
